description: Say it to keep it. A Minecraft 26.3 Fabric mod that teaches the original Japanese item names: pick up an item, say its name into Simple Voice Chat, and keep it, or lose it. Furigana, romaji, offline speech recognition, and native-style pronunciation by VOICEVOX.

mods.name: Kotoba Keep
mods.description: Say it to keep it. Learn the original Japanese Minecraft item names through offline voice challenges. Voice: VOICEVOX:冥鳴ひまり.

releases.notes:
**Say it to keep it.** Pick up an item, say its original Japanese Minecraft name into Simple Voice Chat, and keep it.

### Install
1. Put the JAR below into your `mods/` folder with [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat).
2. Download [vosk-model-small-ja-0.22.zip](https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models/vosk-model-small-ja-0.22.zip) and extract its folder into `config/kotobakeep/`.

Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+ and Java 25. For multiplayer, install it on the server and every client. See the [README](https://github.com/Feeeh/Kotoba-Keep#readme) for how to play.

Voice: **VOICEVOX:冥鳴ひまり**. Unofficial mod, not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Feeeh/Kotoba-Keep/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0
